defs.def: familiar with sth because you do it or experience it often 习惯于；适应adj.

ex.s: Regenerative brakes have been in trains for decades and are also used in some cars.
ex.t: 再生制动技术在列车中已应用了几十年，一些汽车也在使用。

ex.s: They consist of an electric motor which collects energy used in the braking action that would be lost as heat by conventional brakes.
ex.t: 它们由一个电动机构成，该电机收集制动过程中原本会被传统刹车以热量形式耗散的能量。

ex.s: The study used a dataset of 1,600 reviews of Chicago hotels.
ex.t: 该研究使用了1600条芝加哥酒店评论的数据集。

ex.s: “We need to speed up the development of green energy, and it will all get used,” says Wipke.
ex.t: Wipke说：“我们需要加快绿色能源的发展，而它都会被用上。”

ex.s: She generally works with their regular teachers to get lessons and tests being used at their home schools.
ex.t: 伊丽莎白·西姆斯分析了五部伟大小说的最后章节，看看它们包含哪些要点以及如何将其改编用于你自己的作品。

ex.s: Why the ingredients were used.
ex.t: 为什么要使用这些原料。

ex.s: My parents used to live here and my father’s watch was here,” he explained, trying to lift a floorboard.
ex.t: 我父母以前住在这里，我父亲的手表也在这里，”他一边解释，一边试着撬起一块地板。

ex.s: With a little help from his school and the local community centre, Mark used his bricks to build a small bike shelter for his neighbourhood.
ex.t: 在他学校和当地社区中心的一点帮助下，马克用他的砖头为他的邻居建造了一座小型自行车避难所。

ex.s: They can be used in cooking.
ex.t: 它们可以用于烹饪。

ex.s: Why are audio and video increasingly used by university teachers?
ex.t: 为什么大学老师越来越多地使用音频和视频？

ex.s: They are used for public exhibition.
ex.t: 它们用于公众展览。

ex.s: Try your hand at some of the painting tricks used by artists whose works will be in the upcoming exhibition of American Watercolors 1880-1990: Into the Light.
ex.t: 亲手尝试一些画家的绘画技巧，他们的作品将出现在即将举办的“美国水彩1880-1990：走进光明”展览中。

ex.s: When was the last time you used a telephone box?
ex.t: 你上一次使用电话亭是什么时候？

ex.s: The last time I used a phone box for its intended purpose was … 2006.
ex.t: 我上一次为打电话而使用电话亭，是……2006年。

ex.s: As it has been many years since I last used one, I should hardly be surprised that there are no longer any public telephones near my house.
ex.t: 距离我上次使用电话亭已经很多年了，所以我几乎不惊讶我家附近已经没有任何公用电话了。

ex.s: To Eva, “a mile” was used to describe long distances.
ex.t: 对伊娃来说，"一英里"被用来描述很长的距离。

ex.s: The mechanism involves a repurposed reward system originally used to develop habits important for self-care.
ex.t: 这一机制涉及一种被重新利用的奖励系统，该系统原本用于培养对自我照顾很重要的习惯。

ex.s: When he got older, John started to wonder if this process could be used to clean up the messes people were making.
ex.t: 长大后，约翰开始想这个过程是否可以用来清理人类制造的垃圾。

ex.s: Little by little, these different kinds of life got used to one another and formed their own ecosystem.
ex.t: 渐渐地，这些不同的生命形式相互适应，形成了自己的生态系统。

ex.s: She used to be a health worker.
ex.t: 她曾是一名卫生工作者。

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 更近一些时候，随着书籍变得廉价甚至可以随意丢弃，艺术家们开始把它们用作艺术品的原材料——把封面、书页甚至整册书变成绘画和雕塑。

ex.s: In the Digital Age, we’re used to having what we need immediately and right ai our fingertips.
ex.t: 在数字时代，我们习惯了立刻就能得到满足，所需之物尽在指尖。

ex.s: I used to afraid of insects, but last Friday’s biology class make a big change in me.
ex.t: 我过去害怕昆虫，但上周五的生物课让我发生了很大的改变。

ex.s: I parked my car outside the farm and walked past a milking house which had apparently not been used in many years.
ex.t: 我把车停在农场外，走过一间显然多年未用的挤奶房。

ex.s: For the images that an artist creates, viewers will probably get far more enjoyment once they know the process used to create them.
ex.t: 对于艺术家创作的图像，观众一旦知道创作它们所用的过程，就可能获得远为更多的享受。

ex.s: Growing up in San Francisco, Grace Young used to watch her father shop daily in Chinatown for whatever he needed to make traditional Chinese meals at home.
ex.t: 在旧金山长大的格雷丝·杨，常常看着父亲每天在唐人街采购，为他要在家做的传统中餐准备所需的一切。

ex.s: Storytelling is an ancient art form that has been used to hand down legends, tales and factual stories.
ex.t: 讲故事是一种古老的艺术形式，被用来传承传说、故事和纪实性叙述。

ex.s: He used to go to the gym or library after delivering students to schools.
ex.t: 他过去常在送完学生去学校后去健身房或图书馆。

ex.s: Producing food that no one eats wastes the water, fuel, and other resources used to grow it.
ex.t: 生产无人食用的食物，会浪费种植它所用的水、燃料和其他资源。

ex.s: She said: “I used to keep hens when I was younger and had to prepare their breakfast each morning before I went to school. ”
ex.t: 她说："我年轻时也养过母鸡，每天早上上学前得给它们准备早餐。"

ex.s: Whether a driver used their phone.
ex.t: 司机是否使用他们的电话。

ex.s: As we age, even if we're healthy, the heart just isn't as efficient in processing oxygen as it used to be.
ex.t: 随着年龄增长，即使我们身体健康，心脏在处理氧气时也不如从前那么高效了。

ex.s: Where trial-and-error was used, the cockatoos did better than monkeys in similar tests.
ex.t: 在使用试错法的情况下，凤头鹦鹉的表现优于类似测试中的猴子。

ex.s: He showed me how his medical instruments was used.
ex.t: 他给我展示他的医疗器械是如何使用的。

ex.s: Drones are already being used to examine high-tension electrical lines.
ex.t: 它们可以做完全相同的事情来检查铁路线路和其他重要的铁路基础设施，如铁轨的正确位置和道岔。

ex.s: It may be used to justify power imbalance.
ex.t: 它可能被用来证明权力不平衡的合理性。

ex.s: The researchers believe that the findings could help technology companies develop better machines that use air to do their jobs, as suction has long been used in robotics to grab objects.
ex.t: 研究人员认为这些发现可以帮助技术公司开发更好的利用空气工作的机器，因为吸力长期以来一直被用于机器人技术来抓取物体。

ex.s: They shouldn’t be used to fool the public.
ex.t: 不应该用来欺骗公众。

ex.s: We prefer to describe emotional intelligence as a specific set of skills that can be used for either good or bad purposes.
ex.t: 我们更倾向于将情商描述为一组特定的技能，可以用于好的或坏的目的。

ex.s: The ability to accurately understand how others are feeling may be used by a doctor to find how best to help her patients, while a cheater might use it to control potential victims.
ex.t: 准确理解他人感受的能力，医生可以用来找到最好地帮助病人的方法，而骗子可能用它来控制潜在受害者。

ex.s: It's the best way to get rid of your used clothes, score clothes from your friends, and have a party all at the same time.
ex.t: 这是处理你旧衣服、从朋友那儿淘衣服、同时开个派对的最佳方式。

ex.s: For the biggest stadiums in the world, we have used data supplied by the World Atlas list so far, which ranks them by their stated permanent capacity, as well as updated information from official stadium websites.
ex.t: 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们目前使用了世界地图册提供的数据，该数据按公布的固定容量对它们排名，并参考了官方体育场网站的更新信息。

ex.s: Every straw that' s part of Von Wong's artwork likely came from a drink that someone used for only a few minutes.
ex.t: 冯·王艺术作品中的每一根吸管，很可能都来自某人只用了几分钟的一杯饮料。

ex.s: The researchers then tested the dogs’ ability to distinguish between human facial expressions by showing them the other half of the person’s face or images totally different from the ones used in training.
ex.t: 然后研究者通过给狗看那个人脸的另一半、或完全不同于训练所用图像，来测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: Pictures used in the two stages were different
ex.t: 两个阶段使用的图片是不同的。

ex.s: And his dad, Albert, took the money my dad earned and used it to pay family expenses.
ex.t: 而他的爸爸，阿尔伯特，拿走了我爸挣来的钱，用它来支付家庭开支。

ex.s: It used to be that you  drive for miles here without seeing another person, but now there are houses and people everywhere.
ex.t: 过去在这里你可以开车数英里看不到一个人但现在到处都是房子和人。

ex.s: What can we learn about the story used in the procedure?
ex.t: 关于该流程中使用的故事我们能了解到什么？

ex.s: Most of it is stored away or used for research.
ex.t: 其中大部分被储存起来或用于研究。

ex.s: The technology, Strano said, could one day be used to light the rooms or even to turn tree into self-powered street lamps.
ex.t: 将来，该团队希望能开发出一种可以喷洒在植物叶片上的一次性处理版本，能在植物的整个生命周期内持续有效。

ex.s: Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is road testing a new way to keep winter roads ice-free -by spreading on them cheese brine, the salty liquid used to make soft cheeses, like mozzarella.
ex.t: 威斯康星州密尔沃基市正在道路测试一种保持冬季道路无冰的新方法——在上面撒奶酪卤水，即制作马苏里拉奶酪等软奶酪时使用的咸味液体。

ex.s: Many people suspect that all the rock salt used every winter is harming the environment.
ex.t: 许多人怀疑每年使用的所有岩盐都在损害环境。

ex.s: A few characters are used to create a single impression growing out of the theme.
ex.t: 用少数几个人物来创造一个源自主题的单一印象。

ex.s: They should be used in other cities.
ex.t: 它们应该在其它城市使用。

ex.s: Sound can be used as a weapon.
ex.t: 声音可以用作武器。

ex.s: I'm relieved to know that "cool" has a much broader definition than what I used to think.
ex.t: 我很欣慰地知道，"酷"有着比我以前认为的更广泛的含义。

ex.s: Single-use plastic bags are used at most a few times before they   4   (throw) away.
ex.t: 一次性塑料袋最多使用几次就会被___4___（throw）掉。

ex.s: Data collected from the device could be used to recognize different participants based on how they typed, with very low error rates.
ex.t: 从设备中收集的数据可用于根据不同的参与者的打字方式识别不同的参与者，错误率非常低。

ex.s: Performance： A dramatic presentation of the topic no more than 10 minutes long． If special clothes are used， they should truly represent a given period．
ex.t: 表演：对该主题进行的戏剧性展示，时长不超过10分钟。若使用了特殊服装，应真实代表某个特定时期。

ex.s: Moore then used her savings to get her business of the ground.
ex.t: 得到父亲的许可后，她花了两年时间在网上进行研究并进行试验，终于得到了既美味又护齿的配方。

ex.s: Phytoplankton have been used to control global climate
ex.t: 浮游植物已被用于控制全球气候

ex.s: Good Morning Britain’s Susanna Reid is used to grilling guests on the sofa every morning, but she is cooking up a storm in her latest role — showing families how to prepare delicious and nutritious meals on a tight budget.
ex.t: 《早安英国》的苏珊娜·里德习惯每天早上在沙发上盘问嘉宾，但在她最新的角色里，她正大显身手——教家庭如何在预算紧张的情况下准备美味又营养的饭菜。

ex.s: Why is fresh lemon juice used in freezing bananas?
ex.t: 为什么冷冻香蕉时要使用新鲜柠檬汁？

ex.s: A taste for meat is   63   (actual) behind the change: An important part of its corn is used to feed chickens, pigs, and cattle.
ex.t: 对肉的喜好是这一变化背后的___63___（actual）原因：其玉米的重要部分被用来喂养鸡、猪和牛。

ex.s: One study found that a cotton bag must be used at least 131 times to be better for the planet than plastic.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次，才比塑料袋对环境更有利。

ex.s: Each word can be used only once.
ex.t: 每个词只能使用一次。

ex.s: After that, critics used the word kowtow when anyone was too submissive to China.
ex.t: 在英语中，gung-ho是一个形容词，意思是极度兴奋地想做某事。

ex.s: In 1942, he used the word as a training slogan for the 2nd Marine Raider Battalion during World War II.
ex.t: 1942年，他在二战期间将这个词用作第二海军陆战队突击营的训练口号。

ex.s: Not so long ago, money was almost always created and used locally, and bartering was common.
ex.t: 不久以前，货币几乎总是本地创造和使用的，物物交换很普遍。

ex.s: In West Africa, bracelets of bronze or copper were used as cash, especially if the transaction was associated with the slave trade there.
ex.t: 在西非，青铜或铜手镯被用作现金，特别是当交易与当地的奴隶贸易有关时。

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在殖民地其他地方以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛使用。

ex.s: Using shells for money was common throughout the Pacific islands as late as the early 1900s, but Malaita is unique in that they are still used today.
ex.t: 早在1900年代初，整个太平洋岛国就普遍使用贝壳来换取金钱，但Malaita之所以独特，是因为贝壳今天仍在使用。

ex.s: Money was created and was widely used in the world.
ex.t: 世界最早的硬币成分可能是金银的组合。

ex.s: Tobacco was used as coins or paper bills in American in the past.
ex.t: 过去在美国，烟草曾被当作硬币或纸币使用。

ex.s: the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied
ex.t: 薄荷植物的叶子新鲜使用或制成蜜饯。

ex.s: Which of the following words can be used to replace the words underlined "stood in the way of"?
ex.t: 以下哪个词可以用来替换划线词组“stood in the way of”？

ex.s: Metal rods used to move sequoia trees will not be left on the trees.
ex.t: 用来移动sequoia树的金属棒不会留在树上。

ex.s: Each sentence can be used only once.
ex.t: 每个句子只能使用一次。

ex.s: Reading magazines as a family can be used to introduce each other to the various interests that each family member possesses.
ex.t: 全家一起读杂志，可以用来让彼此了解各位家庭成员的各种兴趣。

ex.s: be used to clean the oceans
ex.t: 被用于清洁海洋

ex.s: “This used to be the center of town,” he said.
ex.t: "这里曾经是镇中心，"他说。

ex.s: Because sleepiness is such a problem for teenagers, some school districts have decided to start high school classes later than they used to.
ex.t: 身体内称为激素的化学物质水平的变化不仅使青少年的身体发育出成人特征，还使青少年难以在晚上11点前入睡。

ex.s: Her library used to be a  36  place for all who loved books and liked to share knowledge.
ex.t: 她的图书馆曾经是所有热爱书籍，喜欢分享知识的36个场所。

ex.s: What is different for the speaker to get used to?
ex.t: 对说话者来说有什么不同需要适应的？

ex.s: But in all, only 150 cans will be used up over the cat’s lifetime-and we’ll still have 100 left over for the next cat.
ex.t: 但总的说来，在这只猫的一生中只会用完150罐——我们还会剩下100罐给下一只猫。

ex.s: It is the resources yet to be used
ex.t: 如果情节、人物或词汇用法让你困惑，你可能无法记住你读的内容。

ex.s: How many cans will be used up in a cat’s 15-year lifetime in a recycling economy?
ex.t: 在循环回收经济中，猫15年的一生里会消耗多少个罐子？

ex.s: Google initially used the data collected from users to target advertising better.
ex.t: 谷歌最初利用从用户处收集的数据来更好地定向投放广告。

ex.s: several vaccines are used together
ex.t: 为了讨论治疗麻疹的方法。

ex.s: Eggplants used to be smaller and yellow or white.
ex.t: 茄子以前更小，而且是黄色或白色的。

ex.s: Some nouns and adjectives can be used as verbs, or the other way round.
ex.t: 一些名词和形容词可以用作动词，或者相反的圆形。

ex.s: Some of the language used on the Internet is different to the language used in other forms of communication.
ex.t: 互联网上使用的一些语言与其他形式的交流中使用的语言不同。

ex.s: But people don't take as much exercise as they used to.
ex.t: 但人们不像以前做那么多运动了。

ex.s: Knives and forks are used for most Western food.
ex.t: 大多数西餐都使用刀叉。
